name: seo-suite

plugins.name: seo-suite
plugins.description: Full-spectrum SEO for Claude Code: technical, on-page, content & copywriting, keywords, schema, local, international, e-commerce, media, links, migrations, AI search (AEO/GEO), analytics, competitors and strategy — with standard-library Python auditors, code-computed prioritisation, beginner and expert guides, and cost-aware use of Semrush/Ahrefs/Screaming Frog/DataForSEO.

plugins.name: seo-suite-semrush
plugins.description: Optional connector: the official Semrush MCP server (OAuth, read-only) for seo-suite. Spends Semrush API units under the seo-suite credit guard.

plugins.name: seo-suite-ahrefs
plugins.description: Optional connector: the official Ahrefs MCP server (OAuth, Lite plan or higher) for seo-suite, limited to the SEO tool groups. Spends Ahrefs API units under the seo-suite credit guard.

plugins.name: seo-suite-dataforseo
plugins.description: Optional connector: the official DataForSEO MCP server (local stdio, API login and password) for seo-suite. Pay-as-you-go spend under the seo-suite credit guard.

description: seo-suite: a full-spectrum, evidence-first SEO plugin for Claude Code.
